changes: Added three immutable successor concepts that apply provider-profile principles: first-viewport proof and action, separate sticky contact controls, persistent mobile actions, appointment context, progressive trust and service hierarchy, responsive content/action parity, shallow surfaces, and preview-safe metadata. Client-readiness audit completed with narrow-layout hardening for concept-06 and a content-first mobile-browser hero correction for concept-04. All six concepts now have an ultra-narrow embedded-browser compact mode and high-confidence independent public documentation links; the presentation and concepts were revalidated at 1440 px, 390 px, and 138 px. The live comparison now treats screenshots only as desktop thumbnails: every thumbnail and primary action opens its working responsive website, with sources available as a secondary live link. Concepts 04–06 now present the full approved professional profile internally and remove visitor-facing dependencies on legacy Shiny site routes.
